signals.title: Advanced packaging concentration
signals.summary: CoWoS-class packaging and interposer attach are modeled as concentrated because qualified capacity is specialized; this does not prove a present binding shortage.

signals.title: Small qualified HBM supplier set
signals.summary: HBM qualification and ramp exposure sits with a small group of memory suppliers. Supplier count is a concentration signal, not a claim that all capacity is unavailable.

signals.title: Shared tool layer
signals.summary: Bonding and inspection tools can serve several advanced memory and packaging flows, creating possible migration or allocation exposure as demand scales.

signals.title: Facility and grid dependence
signals.summary: Cluster growth depends on site power, cooling and grid connection. The map flags infrastructure exposure without estimating a regional power deficit.
